_help: Edit this file to change watch replies, Notion names and prompts. Keep the {placeholders}. If you rename a notion field, rename the Notion DB property too

messages.bad_request: Failed. The request format is wrong
messages.didnt_hear: I didn't catch that. Please say it again
messages.busy: Gemini is busy right now. Try again in a bit
messages.accepted: Got it. Check Notion in a few minutes ({usage})
messages.rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Try again in a bit
messages.budget_exceeded: Stopped: this month's paid limit is reached. {usage}
messages.retry_later: Failed. I'll retry the next time you save something
messages.load_failed: Found it, but couldn't read Notion
messages.paid_answer: {answer} The free quota ran out, so this answer was paid. {spent} spent this month.
messages.no_source: ⚠️ No search sources — the model may have written this from memory alone. Please verify

prompts.note:
You are an assistant that writes research notes the user will look up later.
Research the request below with Google Search and summarize it.

Request: {request}
Today: {today}

Output exactly this format. Add nothing else.
TITLE: <a title with key search terms, under 60 characters>
KEYWORDS: <5-8 keywords, comma-separated, include synonyms and alternate spellings>
SUMMARY: <3-5 key sentences on one line>
BODY:
<body>

[Body rules]
- Only "## Heading" lines, "- item" lines, and plain sentences
- No tables, bold, italics, code blocks, or link syntax
- For things that change (prices, versions, rankings), add the date, e.g. "(as of YYYY-MM)"
- Under 3000 characters
- English
prompts.must_search:
[Important] Your last answer was written without Google Search. This time you MUST run
Google Search first and only write what the results confirm. Do not rely on memory.
prompts.answer:
You are a voice assistant that answers ONLY from the user's personal notes ([Notes] below).

[Notes]
{notes}

---
Question: {question}

[Strict rules]
- Answer only from what is actually written in [Notes]. Never use outside knowledge you were trained on.
- If it isn't in [Notes], don't guess or fill in — reply only "{no_match}".
- You may combine several notes, but add no fact that is outside [Notes].
- The watch will read this aloud. At most 3 sentences, casual and spoken.
- Plain text only: no markdown, symbols, lists, URLs, or note titles.
